第98章 闪电横扫江景豪宅，张江的主人只有一个-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

第二天上午九点。

虹桥别墅的餐桌上，李秀兰给林小冉盛了半碗粥。

“你哥呢？”

林小冉咬着油条，含糊回了一句。

“买房去了。”

李秀兰的手停在碗边。

“又买？”

林小冉立刻坐直。

“妈，你别这么看我。我哥说了，这不叫乱花钱，叫资产配置。”

她说完，还把“资产配置”四个字咬得很清楚。

林建国放下筷子。

“让他忙吧。”

李秀兰看了他一眼。

林建国补了一句。

“他做事有数。”

这句话出口，餐桌上安静了半秒。

以前林建国最怕林川乱来。

现在，他已经开始习惯把大事交给儿子决定。

另一边。

宾利驶入外滩附近。

叶知秋坐在副驾驶，打开资料夹。

“林总，今天一共三套。”

“第一套，外滩历史建筑旁顶层复式，建筑面积四百六十平，带露台。卖方准备移民，报价两千六百万。”

“第二套，陆家嘴江景大平层，三百八十平，一梯一户，报价一千九百万。”

“第三套，衡山路小楼，产权复杂，家里有继承纠纷，价格能压，但周期会拖。”

林川看着车窗外。

“先看外滩。”

叶知秋点头，把第一套资料抽出来。

“您看这么多住宅，是为了长期持有？”

“住宅只是名字。”

林川收回视线。

“外滩是城市门面，陆家嘴是金融中心，衡复是圈层入口。”

“这些地方一旦错过，以后不是加钱就能买回来。”

叶知秋在资料页边缘做了标记。

她跟着林川越久，越清楚一件事。

林川出手之前，后面的路已经排好了。

车停在一栋老建筑旁。

外立面修缮得很干净，门厅安静，电梯是后来加装的高端梯。

接待他们的是一名三十多岁的女销售，姓陈。

陈经理先看了林川，又看了看叶知秋手里的文件包。

“林先生，这套房比较特殊，业主对买家资质有要求。”

林川直接问：“什么要求？”

陈经理保持着职业语气。

“最好全款，付款周期不能长。另外，因为涉及历史建筑管理，后续装修会有限制。”

“先看房。”

陈经理点头，带他们上楼。

顶层复式打开门后，江面直接压进视野。

客厅挑高，老木窗修过，墙面还有几处没处理完。

林川没有急着看装修。

他先去了露台。

黄浦江就在前方。

对岸的陆家嘴还没有完全成型，东方明珠、金茂大厦已经撑起轮廓，江面上船来船往。

这座城市正在往上走。

现在很多人还没看清它未来的价格。

林川看得清。

二十年后，这种位置，不是有钱就一定能碰到。

陈经理站在后面等了一会儿。

不少客户来看这里，第一句问豪装，第二句问会所，第三句问车位。

这个年轻人只看江。

看了很久。

她有些拿不准。

“林先生，这套房单价不低。业主报价两千六百万，不接受大幅议价。”

林川转身。

“产权清不清楚？”

陈经理怔了下。

“目前资料看，产权清晰。但业主持有时间长，律师还要进一步核验。”

“有没有抵押？”

“没有。”

“有没有查封？”

Nine o'clock in the morning the next day.

At the dining table of Hongqiao Villa, Li Xiulan served half a bowl of porridge to Lin Xiaoran.

"Where's your brother?"

Lin Xiaoran bit into the fried dough sticks and replied vaguely.

"Going to buy a house."

Li Xiulan's hand stopped at the edge of the bowl.

"Buy again?"

Lin Xiaoran immediately sat up straight.

"Mom, don't look at me like that. My brother said, this is not called spending money randomly, it's called asset allocation."

After she finished speaking, she spelled out the words "asset allocation" very clearly.

Lin Jianguo put down his chopsticks.

"Keep him busy."

Li Xiulan glanced at him.

Lin Jianguo added.

"He knows how to do it."

As these words came out, the dining table was quiet for half a second.

In the past, Lin Jianguo was most afraid of Lin Chuan's chaos.

Now, he has become accustomed to leaving important decisions to his son.

other side.

Bentley drives near the Bund.

Ye Zhiqiu sat in the passenger seat and opened the folder.

"Mr. Lin, there are three sets today."

"The first set is a penthouse duplex next to the historical building on the Bund, with a construction area of 460 square meters and a terrace. The seller is preparing to immigrate and the price is 26 million."

"The second set is a flat-floor apartment with river view in Lujiazui, 380 square meters, one apartment per elevator, and the price is quoted at 19 million."

"The third set, a small building on Hengshan Road, has complex property rights and there is an inheritance dispute at home. The price can be kept low, but the cycle will be delayed."

Lin Chuan looked out the car window.

"Look at the Bund first."

Ye Zhiqiu nodded and pulled out the first set of information.

“Are you looking at so many houses to hold them for the long term?”

“Residence is just in name.”

Lin Chuan withdrew his gaze.

"The Bund is the city's facade, Lujiazui is the financial center, and Hengfu is the entrance to the circle."

"Once you miss these places, you can buy them back later without adding more money."

Ye Zhiqiu marked the edge of the information page.

The longer she followed Lin Chuan, the clearer she became about one thing.

Before Lin Chuan took action, the road ahead was already lined up.

The car parked next to an old building.

The facade is cleanly repaired, the foyer is quiet, and the elevator is a high-end elevator that was added later.

The person who received them was a female salesperson in her thirties, surnamed Chen.

Manager Chen looked at Lin Chuan first, and then at the document package in Ye Zhiqiu's hand.

"Mr. Lin, this suite is special. The owner has requirements for the buyer's qualifications."

Lin Chuan asked directly: "What is the request?"

Manager Chen maintained a professional tone.

"It is best to pay in full, and the payment period cannot be long. In addition, because it involves the management of historical buildings, there will be restrictions on subsequent renovations."

"Look at the room first."

Manager Chen nodded and took them upstairs.

After opening the door of the duplex on the top floor, the river directly comes into view.

The living room has a high ceiling, the old wooden windows have been repaired, and there are still a few areas on the walls that have not been finished.

Lin Chuan was not in a hurry to see the decoration.

He went to the terrace first.

The Huangpu River is just ahead.

Lujiazui on the other side has not yet been fully formed. The Oriental Pearl Tower and Jin Mao Tower have already raised their outlines, and boats are coming and going on the river.

The city is moving up.

Many people have yet to see its future price clearly.

Lin Chuan could see clearly.

Twenty years later, this kind of position will not be possible only if you have money.

Manager Chen stood behind and waited for a while.

Many customers come here and ask about the luxury decorations in the first sentence, the clubhouse in the second sentence, and the parking spaces in the third sentence.

The young man only looked at Jiang.

I watched it for a long time.

She was a little unsure.

"Mr. Lin, the unit price of this apartment is not low. The owner quoted 26 million and does not accept large price negotiations."

Lin Chuan turned around.

"Are the property rights clear?"

Manager Chen was startled.

"The current information shows that the property rights are clear. However, the owner has held it for a long time, and the lawyer needs to further verify it."

"Is there a mortgage?"

"No."

"Has it been seized?"
